gael_10_1.m: And no, I have no soup for anyone!

gael_20.m: Hi kid. I am Gael, son of those people in the house over there.

gael_20_1.m: I moved out here because I couldn't stand the suffocating smell of mushroom soup anymore. Or vegetable soup, for that matter.

gael_20_2.m: I like meat. Wolves, boars, dogs, puppies. Any kind, really.

gael_20_3.m: And snakes, of course. They give the finest meat of all.

gael_20_4.m: Cooked, grilled, baked, fried, stewed...ahh, snake meat - nothing compares to it!
r: To each his own, I guess.
Cooked meat? Who cooks your meat?

gael_20_5.m: Now that I mention it: I am running out of meat. I'll have to go out hunting again.
r: Would you like me to give you some meat?
Good luck! I am leaving then.
Oh, I just noticed that I don't have enough meat with me. I will be back soon with 10 pieces of meat, just you wait.
Here, I have 10 nice pieces of meat for you. I cannot promise that it is all from snakes, though.
Here, I have 10 nice pieces of lamb meat for you. Maybe not as good as snake though.
Here, I have 8 nice pieces of snake meat for you.

gael_20_7.m: Excellent! In return, I can give you this nice little purse, made of the finest snake leather. Look here, isn't it beautiful?
r: Wow, it is magnificent! Thank you!

gael_cook.m: I cook my own meat, thank you very much!
r: I've been looking for a way to cook my meat.

gael_cook_10.m: I could use some extra gold. So I can cook them for you for let's say 30 gold a piece.
r: Well, here is 1 piece and 30 gold.
OK, I have 5 pieces and 150 gold.
Here, I have 10 pieces that I would like cooked. Here are 300 gold pieces too.
I'm hungry! Here are 20 pieces and 600 gold.
Oh, my mistake, I forgot that I have no meat.
Oops, I'm still poor. I can't afford to pay your price.

gael_soup_1.m: You have some of that disgusting soup in your bag! I can smell it.

get_five_cooked_meat.m: Just five? That's no problem. Here's all your cooked meat.

get_one_cooked_meat.m: Only one? That's no problem. Here's your cooked meat.

get_ten_cooked_meat.m: 10 meat at once? That's no problem. Here's all your cooked meat.

get_twenty_cooked_meat.m: 20 meat at once?! You may even love this stuff more than I do. Here's all your cooked meat.

gison_soup.10:
In a hut southwest from Fallhaven I met Alaun.
He asked me to bring him some of the delicious soup made by Gison with forest mushrooms.
Gison's house lies to the south.
gison_soup.20: I found Gison's house and should deliver the soup to Alaun while it is hot.
gison_soup.22: Gison gave me a new soup for 5 gold.
gison_soup.24: Gison gave me a new soup for 50 gold.
gison_soup.26: Gison gave me a new soup for 500 gold.
gison_soup.28: Gison gave me a new soup for 5000 gold. I should really go to Alaun now.
gison_soup.30:
Alaun received the soup.
I should take the empty bottle back to Gison.
gison_soup.35: Alaun told me that Nimael also makes soup.
gison_soup.40: Gison thanked me for bringing the empty bottle back to him.
gison_soup.50:
I spent 5555 gold on buying mushroom soup! Am I crazy? 
There is no soup left for Alaun now.
gison_soup.60: Gison insisted his soup is better than Nimael's.
gison_soup.70: Nimael insisted her soup is better than Gison's.
gison_soup.80: Gison gave me a taste of both soups.
gison_soup.90: Nimael gave me a taste of both soups.
gison_soup.100: Gison said he would talk to Nimael about selling both soups in Fallhaven.
